children: The US Department of Justice asked a federal judge to deny a bid by CNN, MS Now, and Politico to restore their White House press credentials, which were revoked by President Donald Trump following coverage he considered negative.

In a court filing late Tuesday, government lawyers argued the ban is lawful, claiming the news outlets posed a threat to national security. The journalists failed to maintain minimum “standards of professionalism,” including by “publishing sensitive or classified information,” the administration said.

“At the very least, the Government may control reporters’ access to restricted presidential areas, such as the Oval Office, even for viewpoint-discriminatory reasons,” the Justice Department wrote to the court.

The filings came on the eve of an emergency hearing before federal judge Timothy Kelly in Washington. CNN, MS NOW and Politico are asking for the court to immediately restore their access to the White House.

and Politico covered Trump at the United Nations on Tuesday, despite being barred from the White House, as the news organizations prepared for a court hearing challenging the administration's decision.

It is longstanding practice for the White House to select so-called ​pool reporters who follow the president while he travels and disseminate coverage to other media. CNN is a member of the TV pool, which suspended coverage on Monday.
